items.name: c01
items.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 video, exactly 6 seconds, one continuous shot, no cuts. Handcrafted miniature diorama photography, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, warm soft practical light. The attached image is the FIRST FRAME: keep every object's shape, size, colour and position consistent with it. The giant isopod (whenever visible) keeps its exact anatomy and size.
The model requires a single, soft, gelatinous, and translucent body, tapering from a rounded, convex anterior to a pointed rear. The color should be bright pink to reddish-brown. Crucially, it has no head, no eyes, and no bones. The anterior end features a large, flared, veil-like webbed membrane used for swimming. On the underside, include a circular mouth surrounded by short, branched feeding tentacles. Because the skin is highly translucent, a distinct internal tubular intestine must be visible through the body wall. The surface should appear smooth and fleshy, lacking any segments or armor.

TIMELINE
0.0-2.5s: Wide shot, slow tracking camera. A handcrafted miniature diorama of the deep sea with a muted grey-green painted paper backdrop. In the center, a bright pink, highly translucent, gelatinous creature with a rounded anterior and pointed rear drifts slowly. It has no head, no eyes, and no bones. The upper quarter of the frame is a calm, uncluttered dark void. 2.5-6.0s: The camera continues its slow track. The creature's large, flared, veil-like webbed membrane at its anterior undulates gently. Through its smooth, fleshy skin, a distinct internal tubular intestine is clearly visible. Soft, warm practical lighting and strong tilt-shift shallow depth of field emphasize the scale-model photography style.
SOUND: none needed (it will be replaced). No music. No dialogue.
NEVER SHOW: text, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, watermarks; real human hands, fingers or people; extra or different creatures; the isopod growing, shrinking or changing shape; morphing or melting objects; cuts, jump cuts or flicker.
